hook_text: Your microwave makes two decisions every time you use it, and it has never thought once. Two switches and a bulb show you how.
clip_script: Logic is on or off, 1 or 0. A gate takes inputs and follows a rule. AND: two switches in series; only both closed lights the lamp; it guards dangerous things, microwave door AND start, both hands on the guillotine. OR: two switches in parallel; either closed lights the lamp; it raises alarms, any door OR any window, any panic button. AND demands everything; OR accepts anything. The microwave heats on door closed AND start, stops on door open OR timer done. Say which gate the job needs, and you are designing.
visual_style: Whiteboard switches in series lighting a lamp only when both close; then in parallel lighting on either; D and shield symbols; a microwave with two gates labelled.
pacing: Two states, AND circuit and uses, OR circuit and uses, comparison.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find one AND and one OR in your own home.
